violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no certified food manager present when the inspection started.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM listed above arrived during the inspection. Please ensure a CFM is present during all hours of operation.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Employees Informed of Responsibility to Report
violations.observation: One of the food employees is not aware of the reporting procedures concerning information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall inform all food employees and conditional employees of their responsibility to report any information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissable through food as specified under 2-201.11(A). The EHS provided the employee with an Employee Illness Reporting Agreement, which he filled out and signed.

violations.title: Food Packaged, Labeled per Law
violations.observation: Food packaged in the establishment is not labeled in accordance with Law. Rice Krispy treats and chocolate chip cookies being offered for self service are not labeled,as required.
violations.corrective_action: Food packaged in a food establishment for customer self service shall include labels that contain the following information: 1. the common name of the food, 2. the list of major ingredients including artificial colors or preservatives, 3. the total net weight or quantity of the food, 4. the name and place of business of the food manufacturer, packer, or distributor, 5. the name of the food source for each major food allergen contained in the food,6. nutrition labeling and, 7. for any salmonid fish containing canthaxanthin as a color additive, the labeling of the bulk fish container, including a list of ingredients, displayed on the retail container or by other written means. The food employees removed the cookies and treats from the self-service area.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap provided at the bar hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: brats, salsa and pre- cooked chicken breasts were all 43ºF in the Atosta 2-door prep to unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC moved these foods to the walk-in to cool them to 41º and below. CDI.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: pico de gallo and beer cheese was not date marked as required. A container of salsa had dates of 3/13 to 3/21 (9 days), which is 2 days past the limit of 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. The manager dats marked the pico and beer cheese. Be sure to not exceed a 7-day holding period for these foods. The day of prep counts as the first day. CDI.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. There was an unlabeled spray bottle with other spray bottles at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The employee could not identify the contents of the spray bottle and discarded it. Replaced it with quaternary ammonia. CDI. THE CASUAL PINT DUNN LORING (Inspection Date: 03/18/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present where the front door meets the floor. There is a gap at the bottom of the door which can allow pests to enter.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Please seal the gap at the bottom of the front door so that no light is visible from the inside. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: the pico in the Acosta prep unit was 44F and the bratwurst was 45F in the unit
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The manager discard the pico and moved the bratwurst to the main storage refrigerator to cook it down.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. The faucet splitter on the mop sink was the incorrect type for a constant pressure system.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The EHS discussed this with the EHS and recommended they buy and install a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve. The manager ordered the device during the visit and will install it when received.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sinks THROUGHOUT THE FACILITY DO NOT HAVE HOT WATER.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water heater serving the food service establishment is not operable at this time, not able to provide adequate hot water supple to the restaurant.
violations.corrective_action: Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the food establishment. REPAIR THE HOT WATER HEATER TO PROVIDE ADEQUATE SUPPLY OF HOT WATER FOR PROPER HAND WASHING AND OTHER USES FOR YOUR OPPERATION. IF IT CAN NOLONGER BE REPAIRED, REPLACE IT. IF A NEW UNIT IS NEEDED, the water heater shall be approved prior to installation.
